hero.subtitle: Authorization Code Exchange for web and mobile — Microsoft Developer Console setup, API reference, and frontend examples.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Microsoft login is optional and controlled by MICROSOFT_AUTH_ENABLED. When disabled, Microsoft endpoints return 503 Service Unavailable. JWTs are never placed in the redirect URL; the API issues a one-time exchangeCode (Redis, 60 seconds). The same POST /auth/exchange endpoint is shared with other social providers. Tenant is configured via MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID (default common).
items: Profile fetched via GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me after token exchange
Scopes openid, profile, email, User.Read for profile and email
Same token response shape as POST /auth/login

console.title: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) app registration
console.description: Register an app in Microsoft Entra ID → App registrations. Set Redirect URI (Web) to MICROSOFT_CALLBACK_URL. Use MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID (common, organizations, consumers, or a tenant GUID). Scopes: openid profile email User.Read.
steps: Open Azure Portal → Microsoft Entra ID → App registrations → New registration
Create a client secret under Certificates & secrets
Copy Application (client) ID and secret into MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID / MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
Set MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID (default common) and match MICROSOFT_CALLBACK_URL
Grant Microsoft Graph delegated permissions: openid, profile, email, User.Read

env.title: Environment variables
env.description: Loaded from .env via src/config/microsoft-oauth.config.ts (namespace microsoftOAuth on ConfigService). See .env.example.

roles.title: Default roles for new Microsoft users
roles.description: New Microsoft users receive roles: [] by default (same as password register). Set MICROSOFT_OAUTH_DEFAULT_ROLES in .env to a comma-separated list of Role values (e.g. user or user,manager). Existing users linked by email keep their current roles.

flow.title: Sequence
items: User consents on Microsoft; browser hits GET /api/v1/auth/microsoft/callback
API calls https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me, upserts user, stores exchangeCode in Redis, redirects to redirect?code=...
Client POSTs { code } to /api/v1/auth/exchange and receives JWTs

start.title: 1. Start OAuth
start.description: Opens Microsoft consent at https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/oauth2/v2.0/authorize. Query redirect must match a prefix in MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_ALLOWLIST (or omit to use the first allowlist entry). Scopes: openid, profile, email, User.Read.

callback.title: 2. Callback
callback.description: Handled by the API. Token exchange uses https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/oauth2/v2.0/token. Redirects to your app with ?code= (or &code= if the URL already has a query).

exchange.title: 3. Exchange code
exchange.description: Public endpoint shared with other social providers. Consumes the code (single use) and returns the same shape as login.

web.title: Frontend — Web (SPA)
web.description: Typical flow: button starts OAuth in the same window (or popup); a callback route on your frontend origin reads code from the query string and calls exchange.
notes: Add your frontend callback URL to MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_ALLOWLIST (e.g. http://localhost:5173/auth/callback)
MICROSOFT_CALLBACK_URL must point at the Nest API, not the SPA
Store accessToken / refreshToken securely (memory + httpOnly cookie patterns as you prefer)

mobile.title: Frontend — Mobile (deep link)
mobile.description: Use a custom scheme (or universal link) in the allowlist. After Microsoft, the API redirects to myapp://success?code=.... The app opens, parses the code, and calls exchange.
notes: Register the scheme in the OS / Expo app.json
Exchange over HTTPS against your API base URL

security.title: Security notes
items: Redirect URLs must match MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_ALLOWLIST prefixes
Exchange codes are single-use and expire in 60 seconds (Redis)
Existing local users are linked by verified Microsoft email (microsoftId set; roles unchanged)
Microsoft-only users have password null — password login / change-password will fail until a password is set
Email is required from https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me; login fails if Microsoft does not return an email

userModel.title: User model
userModel.description: Postgres entity / interface fields used by Microsoft login:
items: microsoftId — unique nullable Microsoft user id
isActive — set true for new Microsoft users
